svg.title: C.U.T.Y STM32F401 FreeRTOS firmware architecture
svg.desc: USART2 interrupt feeds CommunicationTask, which feeds ServoControlTask through queues; ServoControlTask drives TIM4 PWM; SafetyTask supervises it with the IWDG and battery ADC; DiagnosticsTask and TxTask send telemetry back to the Raspberry Pi.
svg.text: C.U.T.Y STM32F401 firmware: FreeRTOS task architecture
Hardware timers make the pulses; tasks only decide them. Arrows are data flow, dashed lines are supervision.
STM32F401CC Black Pill: FreeRTOS V11.1 + CMSIS-RTOS2, 84 MHz, 1 kHz tick
SafetyTask: High1 (41), every 10 ms, never touches controller state
ServoControlTask beat older than 50 ms: kill PWM pins, stop refreshing IWDG
Battery at 10 Hz: below 9.9 V for 1 s = BATTERY_LOW (latched until 11.0 V)
snapshot to telemetry, LED, DIAG 5 s
Controller states (faults latch, first reason is kept)
PWM only in ACTIVE. FAULT releases the servos; RESET clears it; DISARM always works.
500 ms without HB, bad frame, limit, low battery: released
control task stuck > 50 ms: PWM pins forced low, latched
safety task or scheduler stuck: MCU resets, outputs off
hardware cut of the 6 V servo rail, always available
